a: Synonyms for smart include intelligent, clever, bright.
Antonyms of fast include slow, sluggish.
The plural of mouse (animal) is mice.
Past tense of teach is taught.
Your shows possession; you're means you are.
Then is about time; than is for comparisons.
Lose is a verb; loose means not tight.
Accept means receive; except means excluding.
Advise is the verb; advice is the noun.
In US English practice is both noun and verb; UK often splits practise as verb.
